review: Reviewed the retained round-99 pause of Lin: ordinary-168 failed with 'fetch failed' 163 ms after it started (2026-11-25T09:18:29Z), with no response and no retained failure evidence, so it carries no error code or retry-after. The opt-in transport recovery requires retained transport evidence, so repair issued this technical handoff instead of resuming. The failed call keeps its reservation and is never resent; Lin decides again with a separate charge. The repair ran at 09:19:31Z, 62 s after the failure, which covers the user's 60-second margin for a transport error without retry-after. This recovery installs no package, assigns no interface, reviews no request and changes no source, budget or experimental policy. It only closes the pause, so under longDevelopment.emptyHandoffs 'uncounted' it is not a counted handoff.
